artworks.title: Hector Taking Leave of Andromache
artworks.description: Kauffmann's Sceafton parting — Hector, Andromache and Astyanax at the Scaean Gate before the champion returns to the wall.

artworks.title: Triumphant Achilles
artworks.description: Matsch's Achilleion fresco — Achilles dragging Hector's corpse behind his chariot, Iliad XXII after the chase around the walls.

artworks.title: Andromache Mourning Hector
artworks.description: David's Louvre reception piece — Andromache beside Hector's body after the wall duel, Troy's private grief made public.

artworks.title: Priam Asking Achilles for the Body of Hector
artworks.description: Ivanov's ransom — aged Priam at Achilles' feet for the son dragged around the walls, the Iliad's last mercy.

films.title: Troy
films.description: Brad Pitt's Achilles and Eric Bana's Hector duel outside the walls — Hollywood's most watched restaging of Iliad XXII.

popCulture.title: Hector
popCulture.description: Troy's defender chased three times around the walls — Hector remains the Iliad's human face of doomed courage.

popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.description: Book XXII's duel and the dragging of the corpse still define how epic imagines a city's last champion.
